articles.title: NSE IPO Opens Today: Decoding Strengths, Concerns & Valuation | IPO Street
articles.description: Neha Dave, Special Analyst at MC Pro, joins Moneycontrol's IPO Street to break down everything investors need to know about the National Stock Exchange's much-awaited IPO, which opens for subscription today. Dave walks through the issue details — a ₹22,562-crore offer for sale with a price band of ₹1,700-1,785, valuing NSE at ₹4.42 lakh crore at the upper end. She discusses the exchange's key strengths, including its durable business model, high entry barriers, network effect moat, and position as a direct proxy to India's financialisation story. Dave also flags the key concerns, from heavy reliance on transaction income to regulatory tightening risks around equity options volumes. She rounds off with MC Pro's valuation take and shares whether long-term investors should consider subscribing to the issue.

articles.title: Trump lashes out at Fed after Warsh-backed rate hike, demands rates of 1% or less

The clash also highlights tensions over the Fed’s independence, with Trump linking interest rates to US trade deficits and continuing his broader criticism of officials he has appointed.
